# Kern settings section — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the Kern settings section when rows need a titled block: the group under a name with an explanatory line. `id` and `title` are required — identity for the screen's switching, a name for the reader — and `rows` are the section's row definitions in order, the same data form the screen's sections share, with presets spreading straight into screens. Rows arrive as the `rows` data prop and never as children markup, and there is no collapsible behaviour: sections always show their rows, because hiding is the screen layout's job. The section is labelled by its title with `description` beneath it, so the group announces as a named unit rather than a run of rows.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the Kern settings section when rows need a titled block: the group under a name with an explanatory line — the native twin under the same contract. `id` and `title` are required — stable identity for the section keys, a heading labelling the group for assistive technology — and `rows` are the section's row definitions in order, the same data form the screen's sections share, with presets spreading straight into screens. Rows arrive as the `rows` data prop and never as children markup, and there is no collapsible behaviour: sections always show their rows, because hiding is the screen layout's job. The title heads the group with the description beneath it, so the rows announce under a named heading.
